```lean
import CategoryTheory.MorphismProperty
import CategoryTheory.LiftingExtensions
import Order.WellFounded

open CategoryTheory

theorem lg_target {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] (W : CategoryTheory.MorphismProperty C) (J : Type w)
  [LinearOrder J] [SuccOrder J] [OrderBot J] [WellFoundedLT J] :
  (CategoryTheory.MorphismProperty.coproducts W).pushouts.transfiniteCompositionsOfShape J ≤ W.rlp.llp := by
  have h_stable : W.IsStableUnderTransfiniteCompositionOfShape J :=
    W.IsStableUnderTransfiniteCompositionOfShape.ofIsMultiplicativeOfRespectsIsoOfIsStableUnderFilteredColimits
      W.IsMultiplicative W.RespectsIso W.IsStableUnderFilteredColimits

  have h_pushout_in_rlp : (CategoryTheory.MorphismProperty.coproducts W).pushouts.transfiniteCompositionsOfShape J ≤ W.rlp :=
    CategoryTheory.MorphismProperty.transfiniteCompositionsOfShape_le_transfiniteCompositions W J

  exact h_pushout_in_rlp.trans (W.rlp.llp.trans h_pushout_in_rlp)
```
